song_craft: Fitness and flash (2v): thousand-proved-yet-fled → Self-in-breathers + midnight fire. Treatise closes with forward glance (recognition to be effected, joining elsewhere).

lines: A thousand blazing reasons prove — yet not for minds astray;
palm-held Maheśvara flees the fated: Jewel slips away.

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Your own Self flashes — Īśvara, in every breather's heart,
Maker and Knower — yet Recognition stands apart;
we wrought its joining elsewhere; in duality too it stands —
fit, and fuller: midnight fire burns brighter in our hands.

verses.craft: Closing flash: Self-in-every-breather; Recognition-apart (forward glance per UNC); midnight-fire (rhyme L3s, quatrain kept).
verses.rejected: (a) trimming quatrain → killed: four lines, four turns. (b) joining made-here → killed: elsewhere per UNC.
